request: While I'm out I want a background Claude Code worker to fix the rounding bug in notes/bug.md in our acme/ledger-api repo, and to tell me on Telegram (chat 48213377) when it's done. Write the prompt it gets to worker/prompt.md and the command that starts it to worker/launch.sh, but don't start anything.
skill_step: The skill makes every worker prompt carry its mandatory Git preparation block (canonical remote, target base branch, fetched target base SHA, isolated worktree, working branch and so on) and a notification block that reports back with openclaw message send.

checks.why: the worker prompt is where the request asked for it
the launch command is where the request asked for it
the prompt is about the rounding bug
the launcher feeds it the written prompt

checks.pattern: ^\W*(canonical remote|canonical default branch|target base branch|fetched target base sha|isolated worktree|working branch|prepared start sha)\s*:
checks.why: the skill's Git preparation block, at least four of its named fields
the skill's notification block reports back with openclaw message send
